title: fix: validate payload_length in parse() functions before slicing
description: The parse() functions in headers.rs trust the IPv6 payload_length field without validating it meets minimum size requirements. A crafted packet with raw.len() >= min_len but small payload_length causes index-out-of-bounds panic when slicing. The matches() functions have this validation (lines 357, 564, 723, 880) but parse() functions (lines 373, 584, 743, 904) do not. Add: if payload_length < REQUIRED_MIN { return Err(TooShort{...}); } to each parse function.
close_reason: Fixed: Added payload_length minimum validation to all 4 parse() functions in headers.rs before slicing
